The '''Ilum Orbital Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] operated by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ilum Orbital Station appears in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
